info.name: VAVI Astrology API Collection
info.description: Complete Postman collection for VAVI Astrology backend. Organized by routers with query parameters, request bodies, and token authentication.

item.name: 1. Auth Router
item.description: Authentication endpoints for users and astrologers (Register, Login, OTP verification, Logout).

item.name: 2. Users Router
item.description: User profiles, home screens, prices, verification, and referrals.

item.name: Adjust User Wallet (Admin)
item.description: Admin manually adds or deducts wallet funds for a specified user.

item.name: Get Call Token (Agora RTC)
item.description: Get a fresh Agora RTC token for an active consultation call channel.

item.name: Start Consultation Call
item.description: Start consultation call when accepted and initiate auto-disconnect timer.

item.name: End Consultation Call
item.description: End consultation call, process payment/earnings deduction, and record reason.

item.name: Cancel Consultation Request
item.description: Cancel consultation request during waiting/ringing phase with 0 charges.

item.name: Leave Live Session
item.description: User leaves an active live streaming session.

item.name: 21. Config Router
item.description: Third-party integration configurations and CMS adapters (Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, FAQs).

item.name: Get Integration Config (Admin)
item.description: Fetch all 3rd-party integration configurations (Kundali API, Agora Live SDK, Razorpay).

item.name: Save Integration Config (Admin)
item.description: Update 3rd-party integration credentials and toggle settings.

item.name: Test Integration Connection (Admin)
item.description: Test integration connection for kundali, liveSdk, or payment.

item.name: Get Privacy Policy
item.description: Fetch current Privacy Policy content.

item.name: Update Privacy Policy (Admin)
item.description: Update Privacy Policy text content.

item.name: Get Terms of Service
item.description: Fetch current Terms of Service content.

item.name: Update Terms of Service (Admin)
item.description: Update Terms of Service text content.

item.name: Get Config FAQs
item.description: Fetch current Terms of Service content.

item.name: Update / Bulk Save FAQs (Admin)
item.description: Add or update FAQs list.

item.name: 22. Dashboard Router
item.description: Admin dashboard statistics and system metrics.

item.name: Get Admin Dashboard Stats
item.description: Fetch admin overview stats including total users, astrologers, earnings, and active sessions.

item.name: 23. Payment Router
item.description: Razorpay payment gateway integration (Create Order, Signature Verification, Webhooks).

item.name: Create Razorpay Order (User)
item.description: Create Razorpay Order ID for wallet recharge.

item.name: Verify Razorpay Payment Signature (User)
item.description: Verify Razorpay payment signature and credit user wallet balance.

item.name: Razorpay Webhook Callback (Public)
item.description: Public server-to-server webhook endpoint for Razorpay payment events.

item.name: 24. Price Requests Router
item.description: Admin management of astrologer price change requests.

item.name: Get Price Change Requests (Admin)
item.description: Fetch all pending and historical price change requests from astrologers.

item.name: Approve Price Change Request (Admin)
item.description: Approve a pending price request and update the astrologer's rate.

item.name: Reject Price Change Request (Admin)
item.description: Reject a pending price change request.
